summary: Contract/freeze phase only -- no plugin loading, plugin registry implementation, dependency injection framework, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Turns the ten plugin categories 110A named into stable, versionable contracts. Freezes the eighteen-field canonical Plugin Contract Model and full contracts (allowed/forbidden responsibilities, input/output schema descriptions, lifecycle requirements, security/no-go constraints, failure behavior, current status) for all ten plugin categories in docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_PLUGIN_CONTRACTS.md. Freezes a ten-class Plugin Capability Taxonomy (observe, advise, approve, deny, enforce, execute, audit, notify, store, rollback_prepare) -- current maximum capability actually exercised by any real PCAE code path today is observe; enforce/execute remain undeclarable. Freezes an eight-state Plugin Lifecycle model (defined -> registered -> configured -> healthy -> available, branching to disabled -> failed -> retired) -- contracts only. Freezes compatibility/versioning rules and ten cross-cutting security boundaries, eight of which directly restate guarantees already verified in code (108B/108C/108D/109D). Updates docs/ROADMAP.md with a new Long-Term Runtime Vision section and Roadmap Principle 10 (Pluggable first. Connected second. Automated third. Executable last.). Added docs/PHASE_110_RUNTIME_PLUGIN_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md. 155 new tests, a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (288), governance/autonomy group (1924), and the collectible portion of release/lifecycle regression (1429/1429) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). Documented validation finding (not a regression): test_phase85_integration.py and test_phase87_integration.py (68 tests) did not complete within a practical time budget -- confirmed via live process inspection to be genuinely executing real governance-info subprocesses (pcae decision-log --json, pcae project-state --json), not deadlocked, reproducible identically under both -n auto and serial execution; root cause is these commands' performance degrading as this session's accumulated history (110+ phases, 850+ provenance events) has grown, unrelated to any 110B change and outside this phase's task-contract scope to repair. Also noted: tests/test_bootstrap_session_reporting.py, referenced in this phase's validation command, does not exist anywhere in this repository.
